en: Don't worry about it.
Today I thought I'd teach you my own
secrets of beauty.
Waaaaah... S-stop it!
M-my beautiful body... it's wounded...
Blood is what keeps me eternally young,
the very source of my life...
Far better than any facial mask.
You even have servants?
Thanks to my salon clients, I can now
talk of nothing but you.
Why not have that longish hair of yours curled?
No, thank you.
I'll pass.
I'm happy with my hair as it is.
Yes, it was rather nice.
, my master. Welcome.
Just say the word!
So sleepy...
And Mum keeps scolding me, too. Hmph.
I want to be of use. Your orders...
More and more cuts... and I didn't do a thing.
Weird.
Whoa, whoa! Old man, out of the way!
Don't walk right in the middle of the road.
Oh, I'm sorry about that, sonny.
"Sonny"? How rude. I've got a job already.
I've got to get to work now. So busy!
Walking there is dangerous, you know.
Quite right. I shall be careful.
Work hard at your job.
Old man, you sound just like my mum.
See you!
Aren't you going to work, old man?
Morning, old man.
Looks like you've got time to spare. Lucky.
Grown-ups get more free time. So unfair.
Hey, old man. Taking it easy again today?
I may not look it, but I'm busy.
Mum's wages alone aren't enough to live on.
I bet you're from a good family, old man.
Do come chat with me sometime. Bye now.
note: Also Winifred (msg 275230); wording works for both.

en: Whoa, careful there, sonny.
You could take a nasty fall on a dark street.
Sorry, old man.
I was in a bit of a hurry. I'm starving.
I've got a job already, you know.
Don't you go to school?
School? That's for folks with time
and money. Nothing to do with me.
Mum and me, we both work to earn money.
Well, I'm in a hurry. See you!
I'm in a hurry, see. Bye!
Evening, old man.
We both got through another day's work.
Huh? But wait, do you even work, old man?
Hey, old man. Doing all right?
I'm worn out. I wanna get to bed.
Working at the factory is really tiring.
A bakery or a bookshop would be easier.
Huh? Who are you? What brings you here?
The manager isn't here, you know.
Mmh... What a dreadful smell.
Just what kind of factory is this, sonny?
That's mean. I'm Daniel, I'm 15.
Don't call me "sonny". I work here.
This factory makes glue.
The smell's strong, but you get used to it.
So, what can I do for you?
The smell is so foul, I forgot why I came.
I shall come back another time. Farewell.
Huh? Oh, it's you, old man.
Here for the manager? The boss isn't in.
So this is where you've been working...
Just what kind of factory is this?
So, what do you want?
The smell's no bother once you're used to it.
You again, old man?
Didn't you say the smell was awful?
No sightseeing, all right? We're serious here.
